A separate cursive multi-stroke prefix ending in a hyphen lies above extension; a curved insertion guide rises from immediately before extension toward that prefix. The above-line word is not the two-letter la. The combined corrected wording is la sous-extension, in agreement with Hua’s lexical reading. The main reader reviewed this crop and confirms the above-line prefix and baseline article; no surrounding text is altered.
